turns.content: The cylinder's angular acceleration changes from 3.40 rad/s to 2.00 rad/s while it turns through 20.0 revolutions. Identify the angular speeds and displacement.
Convert the angular displacement to joules.
Under the stated constant-change assumption, write a relation among the initial value, final value, and accumulated third quantity, then isolate the requested change parameter.
Use the initial, final, and accumulated quantities above to calculate the constant torque, while also classifying the sign of the derived change parameter.
Check the conversion used above, numerator sign, and units in that relation.
Report the result, including its units and physical meaning.
